lines.l: We just heard Jeff Cashua with Voices,
and when Jeff brought a song called Simple Truth into the studio,
he had a pretty clear idea of what he wanted.
An upbeat groove, about three and a half minutes, really ready for radio.
But the musician started playing it a lot slower with more of a jazz feel,
so Jeff explained that his song was supposed to be more of an up-tempo R&B pop vibe
until someone who we just talked about earlier, producer Chuck Loeb,
encouraged Jeff to trust him and get his horn to play.
